profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Gamebreaking Studios
profile.summary:
Experienced Senior UI Engineer with over four years in the game industry, working with top-tier clients like
EA and Microsoft. Skilled in developing scalable and maintainable game systems, leading multiple projects,
and mentoring new hires. Passionate about creating engaging gameplay experiences and fostering a
collaborative development culture.

positions.title: Game Programmer | Technical Designer
positions.description:
Game: Archer's Paradox (Final Project)

Archer's Paradox is a third person, local co-op, medieval fantasy game. The players will control Lance and Abigail, archers who acquire magical powers. With their new skills, they can manipulate time by shooting magical time arrows. They have to work together to stop a group of cultists residing in an old castle from summoning Abaddon the Destroyer, an ancient and evil god, who intends to corrupt all the realms for world domination.

Engine: Unity (HDRP)
Script language: C#

I worked remotely in a core team of 6 game design students and 1 sound designer.

As a Programmer, I:
- Developed the player's core mechanics.
- Implemented shooting mechanic with different states and aim assist. 
- Created 4 Different AI behaviors.
- Implemented animations and VFX in-game.
- Developed boss battle patterns and states.
- Created a dynamic loading system.
- Developed interactable elements. Pressure plates, moving platforms, shootable flames, traps, pickups, and magic targets.
- Implemented UI menus and HUD.
- Iterated in quick prototypes to playtest mechanics.
- Implemented cutscenes in engine.

As a Technical Designer, I:
- Developed a Technical Desing Document.
- Designed shooting mechanic.
- Worked with the design team to design the puzzle room.
- Discussed ideas with other teammates to improve the game's design.
- Observed, took notes, and asked questions on playtesting sessions.

positions.title: Game Programmer | Technical Designer
positions.description:
Game: Yaoyotl

Yaoyotl is a 3rd person 3D Aztec god boss rush where the player plays as an Aztec warrior fighting different gods in different arenas. The player will need quick reactions and a vigilant eye to properly manage their shifting surroundings and deal with the gods' terrifying attacks.

Yaoyotl was developed by a team of 4 during Vancouver Film School's Team Project class.

Engine: Unity (HDRP)
Script language: C#

As a Programmer, I:
- Developed the player's core mechanics.
- Created a quick time event system.
- Developed different boss attacks and states.
- Implemented different stage states.
- Implemented UI menus and HUD.
- Created Visual Effects

As a Technical Designer, I:
- Design core mechanics.
- Discussed ideas with other teammates to improve the game's design.

positions.title: Level Designer | Programmer
positions.description:
Levels for: Quest for Valor

Engine: Unreal 4
Scripting Language: Blueprints (Visual Scripting)

As a Level Designer, I:
- Created 2D layout.
- Created a Level Design Document.
- Created level blockout.
- Designed puzzle and cinematics.
- Set dressed the levels.
- Balanced the pacing and difficulty.
- Implemented the concepts learned in the Level Design Stream.
- Held playtesting sections.
- Designed a new mechanic in the game.
- Designed boss battle.

As a programmer, I:
- Implemented gameplay and level logic.
- Created a checkpoint system.
- Implemented a feedback system triggering music, SFX, and VFX using blueprints.
- Developed my own mechanic.

positions.description:

The Void Above Us was developed by a team of 4 during Vancouver Film School's May 2020 Game Jam. Made in 50 hours over 3 days with the theme "Contain".

Engine: Unity (HDRP)
Script language: C#

As a Programmer, I:
- Developed the player's core mechanics.

positions.title: Virtual Reality Software Engineer
positions.description:
Virtual Reality educational application to help mathematics students to visualize and analyze complex 3D graphics.

Engine: Unity
Script language: C#
VR: HTC Vive

As a programmer, I:
- Developed user interactions.
- Implemented menu and controllers.
- Developed application logic.

As a designer, I:
- Researched target user's needs.
- Designed user interactions.
- Designed simple and understandable controls for no VR experience users.
- Tested with 80 target users.
- Designed test forms.
- Worked close with experts in math and teaching to improve the experience.

positions.title: Virtual Reality Software Engineer | Designer
positions.description:
N2B8 is an application that is meant to help teachers test their students’ medical knowledge during the second year of their study. They must put the theory that they’ve studied during their first year into practice in the virtual world by learning step by step how to prepare for intubation successfully, and after that perform the actual intubation. By exercising in the virtual world, they can visualize what a real operating theatre looks like, they will learn how to work under pressure and they can also see what can go wrong during the operation without any consequences in the real world.

Engine: Unity
Script language: C#
VR: HTC Vive

As a programmer, I:
- Implemented player interactions.
- Developed application logic.
- Developed different prototypes.

As a designer, I: 
- Created design documents.
- Research about real-life intubation experience. 
- Present to client ideas and prototypes.
- Designed user's activities inside the application.
- Guided tests with final users.

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description:
2D Action platformer game, where the player controls an archer that must defeat find a diamond in each level. 50 Different levels with new mechanics and challenges every 10 levels. 

As a programmer, I: 
- Developed the player's core mechanics.
- Implemented game logic.
- Developed interactable elements.
- Developed boss battles and enemies.

As a Designer, I:
- Designed 50 levels.
- Designed 5 unique mechanics.
- Designed boss battles and enemies.
